Return policy

Unopened products in original packaging may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange.

How to start a return

Contact our customer care team with your order number. We'll provide a prepaid return label where eligible and guide you through the process.

Refunds

Refunds are processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days after we receive and inspect your return.
